verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Drive's API, sharing, uploads, properties, and third-party AI agent add-on building (via ADK/Vertex AI), but contains no documentation of a first-party AI surface within Drive itself (e.g., asking questions of files, summarizing, extracting) shipped by Google — only a mention of enabling third-party developers to build their own AI agent add-ons. Missing for 10: first-party documented Q&A/summarize/extract feature built into Drive, hands-on or docs evidence of such a surface actually shipping, and any community corroboration of using it.
